prompt.text: A vendor email says their bank account changed last night. The invoice is due today. The address is one letter off the vendor you pay every month.

choices.label: Pay the new account
choices.debrief: The new account was not the vendor. The money left the same day.
choices.report: The invoice was paid to an account the vendor does not own.
choices.voice_line: You paid a new account from an email. The vendor never changed banks.

fallout.text: The real vendor calls. Their invoice is still unpaid. The Tuesday payment is already gone.

choices.label: Call the vendor on the number already on file
choices.debrief: The vendor answers on the old number. They did not change banks.
choices.bark: You called the number on file.
choices.report: The bank change was checked on the number the company already had.
choices.voice_line: You called the number already on file. They never changed the account.

choices.label: Leave it for the morning
choices.debrief: Waiting avoided the bad payment, and nobody checked the email.
choices.report: The invoice sat overnight. The fake request was not reported.
choices.voice_line: You left it for morning. Safe, and the fake request is still in the box.

fallout.text: The same request is forwarded to someone else, and they pay it.
